description:
🚀 Welcome to SpaceHack!

We are a passionate team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Karwar Local Event.

Our mission is to bring forgotten space exploration history back to life through creativity, technology, research, and storytelling.

For the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten," we aim to explore NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars and transform their stories into an engaging, interactive digital experience.
